selectedBrief: Subject: EXACTLY ONE corked medicine bottle, not the old reference's pair. A squat sturdy muted teal glass bottle with a wide cylindrical body and broad shoulders, seen in a gentle three-quarter view. Plain tan cork, thick glass lip, one clearly visible BLUE THREAD tied around the neck with two short dangling ends. Keep a few broad flat reflections to indicate glass, but the body remains visually solid and readable, not nearly invisible. One distinct jagged dark CRACK runs down the exposed glass shoulder and lower side, visibly continuous where not covered, not shattered or leaking. Around the middle are TWO retained torn cream paper LABEL FRAGMENTS, meeting at a visible torn split. They wrap around adjacent front and side surfaces so BOTH can be seen at this angle: one has just two short rows of large disconnected angular nonverbal strokes; the other just two short rows of large soft curved nonverbal strokes. These are abstract marks representing two distinct national writing systems with NO readable lettering, words or literal invented language. Let the large contrasting angular versus curved marks read at128px, no dense tiny writing. A simple narrow aged cloth reinforcement band near the lower bottle may echo the old material without hiding the crack or labels. Keep one complete bottle centered, all edges and blue tie ends inside generous margins. No second bottle, loose paper, hand, person, symbols, medicine cross or extra objects. Narrative roles: one saved cracked vessel retains two scripts; cannot communicate that merely with two colors.
approval: Parent confirmed 2026-10-20: reconstruct single cracked two-script bottle with blue thread; three independent keys with no common ring; detachable mandate clasp with silver-sand two-chamber timer and separate release pin. Do not claim exact source restoration.

45: 难民从中桥出现时，8 岁的艾达抱着一只裂开的药瓶。她说洛恩口音，却穿维尔萨军屯衣物，拒绝回答属于哪一国。
